source.snapshot_algorithm: SHA-256 over sorted UTF-8 relative path, NUL, file SHA-256 hex, newline records

changes: SharedNodeState now names the neutral fs_state, process_state, and async_hooks_state owners directly; legacy adapters re-export those same state types where still needed.
Network-family timeout policy has one neutral owner in modules/net_config.rs.
The shared TCP transport now lives in modules/net_shared_vm.rs; modules/net re-exports it for remaining adapter paths.
Filesystem descriptor state no longer opens write streams through the legacy fs::ops adapter; the shared stream adapter opens the file and inserts it into the shared descriptor table.

The legacy readline adapter and readline-promises source fragment were removed outside the selected framework gate. Existing broader diagnostic inventory rows remain unchanged and are not qualified by this record.

commands.command: cargo build --profile iteration -p quench-node --bin quench-node -p quench-node-test --bin run-parallel

framework_scenarios.comparison: Each package ran serially in Node and Quench; exit statuses and raw stdout/stderr were compared with cmp.

qualification_limit: These checks bind the current shared Node adapter changes to the framework gate. No unit tests, full Test262 run, Wasm run, or production-profile build was run. quench-node still directly depends on quench-runtime and compiles legacy value adapters, so Task 27 and Stage A remain open.
